verses.original: הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ בָּבֶ֖ל אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים בְּיַ֖ד יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh ’el- bā·ḇel ’el- ’e·reṣ kaś·dîm bə·yaḏ yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî
verses.literal: This is the word that the LORD spoke through Jeremiah the prophet concerning Babylon and the land of the Chaldeans

verses.original: הַגִּ֨ידוּ בַגּוֹיִ֤ם וְהַשְׁמִ֙יעוּ֙ וּֽשְׂאוּ־ נֵ֔ס הַשְׁמִ֖יעוּ אַל־ תְּכַחֵ֑דוּ אִמְרוּ֩ נִלְכְּדָ֨ה בָבֶ֜ל הֹבִ֥ישׁ בֵּל֙ חַ֣ת מְרֹדָ֔ךְ הֹבִ֣ישׁוּ עֲצַבֶּ֔יהָ חַ֖תּוּ גִּלּוּלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: hag·gî·ḏū ḇag·gō·w·yim wə·haš·mî·‘ū ū·śə·’ū- nês haš·mî·‘ū ’al- tə·ḵa·ḥê·ḏū ’im·rū nil·kə·ḏāh ḇā·ḇel hō·ḇîš bêl ḥaṯ mə·rō·ḏāḵ hō·ḇî·šū ‘ă·ṣab·be·hā ḥat·tū gil·lū·le·hā
verses.literal: Announce and declare to the nations lift up a banner and proclaim it hold nothing back when you say Babylon is captured Bel is put to shame Marduk is shattered her images are disgraced her idols are broken in pieces

verses.original: כִּ֣י עָלָה֩ עָלֶ֨יהָ גּ֜וֹי מִצָּפ֗וֹן הֽוּא־ יָשִׁ֤ית אֶת־ אַרְצָהּ֙ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה וְלֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בָּ֑הּ מֵאָדָ֥ם וְעַד־ בְּהֵמָ֖ה נָ֥דוּ הָלָֽכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ‘ā·lāh ‘ā·le·hā gō·w miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn hū- yā·šîṯ ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣāh lə·šam·māh wə·lō- yih·yeh yō·wō·šêḇ bāh mê·’ā·ḏām wə·‘aḏ- bə·hê·māh nā·ḏū hā·lā·ḵū
verses.literal: For a nation from the north will come against her it will make her land a desolation No one will live in it both man and beast will flee . . .

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֨ים הָהֵ֜מָּה וּבָעֵ֤ת הַהִיא֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה יָבֹ֧אוּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הֵ֥מָּה וּבְנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָ֖ה יַחְדָּ֑ו הָל֤וֹךְ וּבָכוֹ֙ יֵלֵ֔כוּ וְאֶת־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם יְבַקֵּֽשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm·māh ū·ḇā·‘êṯ ha·hî nə·’um- Yah·weh yā·ḇō·’ū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl hêm·māh ū·ḇə·nê- yə·hū·ḏāh yaḥ·dāw hā·lō·wḵ ū·ḇā·ḵōw yê·lê·ḵū wə·’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem yə·ḇaq·qê·šū
verses.literal: In those days and at that time declares the LORD the children of Israel . . . and the children of Judah will come together weeping . . . as they come and will seek the LORD their God

verses.original: צִיּ֣וֹן יִשְׁאָ֔לוּ דֶּ֖רֶךְ הֵ֣נָּה פְנֵיהֶ֑ם בֹּ֚אוּ וְנִלְו֣וּ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָ֖ם לֹ֥א תִשָּׁכֵֽחַ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ṣî·yō·wn yiš·’ā·lū de·reḵ hên·nāh p̄ə·nê·hem bō·’ū wə·nil·wū ’el- Yah·weh bə·rîṯ ‘ō·w·lām lō ṯiš·šā·ḵê·aḥ
verses.literal: They will ask the way to Zion and turn their faces toward it They will come and join themselves to the LORD in an everlasting covenant that will never be forgotten

verses.original: צֹ֤אן אֹֽבְדוֹת֙ הָיָה עַמִּ֔י רֹעֵיהֶ֣ם הִתְע֔וּם הָרִ֖ים שׁוֹבֵבִים מֵהַ֤ר אֶל־ גִּבְעָה֙ הָלָ֔כוּ שָׁכְח֖וּ רִבְצָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ṣōn ’ō·ḇə·ḏō·wṯ hå̄·yå̄h ‘am·mî rō·‘ê·hem hiṯ·‘ūm hā·rîm šō·ḇē·ḇīm mê·har ’el- giḇ·‘āh hā·lā·ḵū šā·ḵə·ḥū riḇ·ṣām
verses.literal: My people are lost sheep their shepherds have led them astray causing them to roam the mountains They have wandered from mountain to hill they have forgotten their resting place

verses.original: כָּל־ מוֹצְאֵיהֶ֣ם אֲכָל֔וּם וְצָרֵיהֶ֥ם אָמְר֖וּ לֹ֣א נֶאְשָׁ֑ם תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָטְא֤וּ לַֽיהוָה֙ נְוֵה־ צֶ֔דֶק וּמִקְוֵ֥ה אֲבֽוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- mō·wṣ·’ê·hem ’ă·ḵā·lūm wə·ṣā·rê·hem ’ā·mə·rū lō ne’·šām ta·ḥaṯ ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭə·’ū Yah·weh nə·wêh- ṣe·ḏeq ū·miq·wêh ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·hem Yah·weh
verses.literal: All who found them devoured them and their enemies said We are not guilty for they have sinned against the LORD their true pasture the LORD the hope of their fathers

verses.original: נֻ֚דוּ מִתּ֣וֹךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וּמֵאֶ֥רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֖ים יָצְאוּ וִהְי֕וּ כְּעַתּוּדִ֖ים לִפְנֵי־ צֹֽאן׃
verses.transliteration: nu·ḏū mit·tō·wḵ bā·ḇel ū·mê·’e·reṣ kaś·dîm yå̄·ṣə·ʾū wih·yū kə·‘at·tū·ḏîm lip̄·nê- ṣōn
verses.literal: Flee from the midst of Babylon depart from the land of the Chaldeans be like the he-goats that lead the flock

verses.original: כִּ֣י הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִ֡י מֵעִיר֩ וּמַעֲלֶ֨ה עַל־ בָּבֶ֜ל קְהַל־ גּוֹיִ֤ם גְּדֹלִים֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן וְעָ֣רְכוּ לָ֔הּ מִשָּׁ֖ם תִּלָּכֵ֑ד חִצָּיו֙ כְּגִבּ֣וֹר מַשְׁכִּ֔יל לֹ֥א יָשׁ֖וּב רֵיקָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî mê·‘îr ū·ma·‘ă·leh ‘al- bā·ḇel qə·hal- gō·w·yim gə·ḏō·lîm mê·’e·reṣ ṣā·p̄ō·wn wə·‘ā·rə·ḵū lāh miš·šām til·lā·ḵêḏ ḥiṣ·ṣāw kə·ḡib·bō·wr maš·kîl lō yā·šūḇ rê·qām
verses.literal: For behold I stir up and bring against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the land of the north They will line up against her from the north she will be captured Their arrows will be like skilled warriors who do not return empty-handed

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֥ה כַשְׂדִּ֖ים לְשָׁלָ֑ל כָּל־ שֹׁלְלֶ֥יהָ יִשְׂבָּ֖עוּ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ḵaś·dîm lə·šā·lāl kāl- šō·lə·le·hā yiś·bā·‘ū nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Chaldea will be plundered all who plunder her will have their fill declares the LORD

verses.original: כִּ֤י תִשְׂמְחִי כִּ֣י תַעֲלְזִי שֹׁסֵ֖י נַחֲלָתִ֑י כִּ֤י תָפוּשִׁי כְּעֶגְלָ֣ה דָשָׁ֔ה וְתִצְהֲלִי כָּאֲבִּרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯiś·mə·ḥī kî ṯa·ʿăl·zī šō·sê na·ḥă·lā·ṯî kî ṯå̄·p̄ū·šī kə·‘eḡ·lāh ḏā·šāh wə·ṯiṣ·hă·lī kā·’ăb·bi·rîm
verses.literal: Because you rejoice because you sing in triumph you who plunder My inheritance because you frolic like a heifer treading grain and neigh like stallions

verses.original: בּ֤וֹשָׁה אִמְּכֶם֙ מְאֹ֔ד חָפְרָ֖ה יֽוֹלַדְתְּכֶ֑ם הִנֵּה֙ אַחֲרִ֣ית גּוֹיִ֔ם מִדְבָּ֖ר צִיָּ֥ה וַעֲרָבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bō·wō·šāh ’im·mə·ḵem mə·’ōḏ ḥā·p̄ə·rāh yō·w·laḏ·tə·ḵem hin·nêh ’a·ḥă·rîṯ gō·w·yim miḏ·bār ṣî·yāh wa·‘ă·rā·ḇāh
verses.literal: your mother will be greatly ashamed she who bore you will be disgraced Behold she will be the least of the nations a wilderness a dry land and a desert

verses.original: מִקֶּ֤צֶף יְהוָה֙ לֹ֣א תֵשֵׁ֔ב וְהָיְתָ֥ה שְׁמָמָ֖ה כֻּלָּ֑הּ כֹּ֚ל עֹבֵ֣ר עַל־ בָּבֶ֔ל יִשֹּׁ֥ם וְיִשְׁרֹ֖ק עַל־ כָּל־ מַכּוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: miq·qe·ṣep̄ Yah·weh lō ṯê·šêḇ wə·hā·yə·ṯāh šə·mā·māh kul·lāh kōl ‘ō·ḇêr ‘al- bā·ḇel yiš·šōm wə·yiš·rōq ‘al- kāl- mak·kō·w·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: Because of the wrath of the LORD she will not be inhabited she will become completely desolate All who pass through Babylon will be horrified and will hiss at all her wounds

verses.original: עִרְכ֨וּ עַל־ בָּבֶ֤ל׀ סָבִיב֙ כָּל־ דֹּ֣רְכֵי קֶ֔שֶׁת יְד֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יהָ אַֽל־ תַּחְמְל֖וּ אֶל־ חֵ֑ץ כִּ֥י לַֽיהוָ֖ה חָטָֽאָה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ir·ḵū ‘al- bā·ḇel sā·ḇîḇ kāl- dō·rə·ḵê qe·šeṯ yə·ḏū ’ê·le·hā ’al- taḥ·mə·lū ’el- ḥêṣ kî Yah·weh ḥā·ṭā·’āh
verses.literal: Line up in formation . . . around Babylon all you who draw the bow Shoot at her Spare no . . . arrows For she has sinned against the LORD

verses.original: הָרִ֨יעוּ עָלֶ֤יהָ סָבִיב֙ נָתְנָ֣ה יָדָ֔הּ נָֽפְלוּ֙ אַשְׁוִיֹּתֶיהָ נֶהֶרְס֖וּ חֽוֹמוֹתֶ֑יהָ כִּי֩ נִקְמַ֨ת יְהוָ֥ה הִיא֙ הִנָּ֣קְמוּ בָ֔הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשְׂתָ֖ה עֲשׂוּ־ לָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·rî·‘ū ‘ā·le·hā sā·ḇîḇ nā·ṯə·nāh yā·ḏāh nā·p̄ə·lū ʾaš·wī·yō·ṯɛ·hå̄ ne·her·sū ḥō·w·mō·w·ṯe·hā kî niq·maṯ Yah·weh hî hin·nā·qə·mū ḇāh ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śə·ṯāh ‘ă·śū- lāh
verses.literal: Raise a war cry against her on every side She has thrown up her hands in surrender her towers have fallen her walls are torn down Since this is the vengeance of the LORD take out your vengeance upon her as she has done do the same to her

verses.original: כִּרְת֤וּ זוֹרֵ֙עַ֙ מִבָּבֶ֔ל וְתֹפֵ֥שׂ מַגָּ֖ל בְּעֵ֣ת קָצִ֑יר מִפְּנֵי֙ חֶ֣רֶב הַיּוֹנָ֔ה אִ֤ישׁ אֶל־ עַמּוֹ֙ יִפְנ֔וּ וְאִ֥ישׁ לְאַרְצ֖וֹ יָנֻֽסוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kir·ṯū zō·w·rê·a‘ mib·bā·ḇel wə·ṯō·p̄êś mag·gāl bə·‘êṯ qā·ṣîr mip·pə·nê ḥe·reḇ hay·yō·w·nāh ’îš ’el- ‘am·mōw yip̄·nū wə·’îš lə·’ar·ṣōw yā·nu·sū
verses.literal: Cut off the sower from Babylon and the one who wields the sickle at harvest time In the face of the oppressor’s sword each will turn to his own people each will flee to his own land

verses.original: שֶׂ֧ה פְזוּרָ֛ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֲרָי֣וֹת הִדִּ֑יחוּ הָרִאשׁ֤וֹן אֲכָלוֹ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וְזֶ֤ה הָאַחֲרוֹן֙ עִצְּמ֔וֹ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֖ר מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: śeh p̄ə·zū·rāh yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·rā·yō·wṯ hid·dî·ḥū hā·ri·šō·wn ’ă·ḵā·lōw me·leḵ ’aš·šūr wə·zeh hā·’a·ḥă·rō·wn ‘iṣ·ṣə·mōw nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ bā·ḇel
verses.literal: Israel is a scattered flock chased away by lions The first to devour him was the king of Assyria . . . the last to crush his bones was Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְנִ֥י פֹקֵ֛ד אֶל־ מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וְאֶל־ אַרְצ֑וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּקַ֖דְתִּי אֶל־ מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl hin·nî p̄ō·qêḏ ’el- me·leḵ bā·ḇel wə·’el- ’ar·ṣōw ka·’ă·šer pā·qaḏ·tî ’el- me·leḵ ’aš·šūr
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel . . . says I will punish . . . the king of Babylon . . . and his land as I punished . . . the king of Assyria

verses.original: וְשֹׁבַבְתִּ֤י אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־ נָוֵ֔הוּ וְרָעָ֥ה הַכַּרְמֶ֖ל וְהַבָּשָׁ֑ן וּבְהַ֥ר אֶפְרַ֛יִם וְהַגִּלְעָ֖ד תִּשְׂבַּ֥ע נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šō·ḇaḇ·tî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ’el- nā·wê·hū wə·rā·‘āh hak·kar·mel wə·hab·bā·šān ū·ḇə·har ’ep̄·ra·yim wə·hag·gil·‘āḏ tiś·ba‘ nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: I will return Israel to his pasture and he will graze on Carmel and Bashan his soul will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and Gilead

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵם֩ וּבָעֵ֨ת הַהִ֜יא נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֗ה יְבֻקַּ֞שׁ אֶת־ עֲוֺ֤ן יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאֵינֶ֔נּוּ וְאֶת־ חַטֹּ֥את יְהוּדָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א תִמָּצֶ֑אינָה כִּ֥י אֶסְלַ֖ח לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר אַשְׁאִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm ū·ḇā·‘êṯ ha·hî nə·’um- Yah·weh yə·ḇuq·qaš ’eṯ- ‘ă·wōn yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ê·nen·nū wə·’eṯ- ḥaṭ·ṭōṯ yə·hū·ḏāh wə·lō ṯim·mā·ṣe·nāh kî ’es·laḥ la·’ă·šer ’aš·’îr
verses.literal: In those days and at that time declares the LORD a search will be made for Israel’s guilt but there will be none and for Judah’s sins but they will not be found for I will forgive the remnant I preserve

verses.original: עַל־ הָאָ֤רֶץ מְרָתַ֙יִם֙ עֲלֵ֣ה עָלֶ֔יהָ וְאֶל־ יוֹשְׁבֵ֖י פְּק֑וֹד חֲרֹ֨ב וְהַחֲרֵ֤ם אַֽחֲרֵיהֶם֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וַעֲשֵׂ֕ה כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתִֽיךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ mə·rā·ṯa·yim ‘ă·lêh ‘ā·le·hā wə·’el- yō·wō·šə·ḇê pə·qō·wḏ ḥă·rōḇ wə·ha·ḥă·rêm ’a·ḥă·rê·hem nə·’um- Yah·weh wa·‘ă·śêh kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî·ḵā
verses.literal: Go up . . . against the land of Merathaim and against the residents of Pekod Kill them and devote them to destruction . . . Do all that I have commanded you declares the LORD

verses.original: ק֥וֹל מִלְחָמָ֖ה בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְשֶׁ֖בֶר גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl mil·ḥā·māh bā·’ā·reṣ wə·še·ḇer gā·ḏō·wl
verses.literal: The noise of battle is in the land the noise of great destruction

verses.original: אֵ֤יךְ נִגְדַּע֙ וַיִּשָּׁבֵ֔ר פַּטִּ֖ישׁ כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ אֵ֣יךְ הָיְתָ֧ה לְשַׁמָּ֛ה בָּבֶ֖ל בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’êḵ niḡ·da‘ way·yiš·šā·ḇêr paṭ·ṭîš kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ ’êḵ hā·yə·ṯāh lə·šam·māh bā·ḇel bag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: How the hammer of the whole earth lies broken and shattered What a horror Babylon has become among the nations

verses.original: יָקֹ֨שְׁתִּי לָ֤ךְ וְגַם־ נִלְכַּדְתְּ֙ בָּבֶ֔ל וְאַ֖תְּ לֹ֣א יָדָ֑עַתְּ נִמְצֵאת֙ וְגַם־ נִתְפַּ֔שְׂתְּ כִּ֥י בַֽיהוָ֖ה הִתְגָּרִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: yā·qō·šə·tî lāḵ wə·ḡam- nil·kaḏt bā·ḇel wə·’at lō yā·ḏā·‘at nim·ṣêṯ wə·ḡam- niṯ·paśt kî Yah·weh hiṯ·gā·rîṯ
verses.literal: I laid a snare for you O Babylon and you were caught before you knew it You were found . . . and captured because you challenged the LORD

verses.original: פָּתַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ א֣וֹצָר֔וֹ וַיּוֹצֵ֖א אֶת־ כְּלֵ֣י זַעְמ֑וֹ כִּי־ מְלָאכָ֣ה הִ֗יא לַֽאדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: pā·ṯaḥ Yah·weh ’eṯ- ’ō·w·ṣā·rōw way·yō·w·ṣê ’eṯ- kə·lê za‘·mōw kî- mə·lā·ḵāh hî la·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ bə·’e·reṣ kaś·dîm
verses.literal: The LORD has opened His armory and brought out His weapons of wrath for this is the work of the Lord GOD of Hosts in the land of the Chaldeans

verses.original: בֹּֽאוּ־ לָ֤הּ מִקֵּץ֙ פִּתְח֣וּ מַאֲבֻסֶ֔יהָ סָלּ֥וּהָ כְמוֹ־ עֲרֵמִ֖ים וְהַחֲרִימ֑וּהָ אַל־ תְּהִי־ לָ֖הּ שְׁאֵרִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: bō·’ū- lāh miq·qêṣ piṯ·ḥū ma·’ă·ḇu·se·hā sāl·lū·hā ḵə·mōw- ‘ă·rê·mîm wə·ha·ḥă·rî·mū·hā ’al- tə·hî- lāh šə·’ê·rîṯ
verses.literal: Come against her from the farthest border Break open her granaries pile her up like mounds of grain Devote her to destruction leave her no survivors

verses.original: חִרְבוּ֙ כָּל־ פָּרֶ֔יהָ יֵרְד֖וּ לַטָּ֑בַח ה֣וֹי עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ בָ֥א יוֹמָ֖ם עֵ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥir·ḇū kāl- pā·re·hā yê·rə·ḏū laṭ·ṭā·ḇaḥ hō·w ‘ă·lê·hem kî- ḇā yō·w·mām ‘êṯ pə·qud·dā·ṯām
verses.literal: Kill all her young bulls let them go down to the slaughter Woe to them for their day has come the time of their punishment

verses.original: ק֥וֹל נָסִ֛ים וּפְלֵטִ֖ים מֵאֶ֣רֶץ בָּבֶ֑ל לְהַגִּ֣יד בְּצִיּ֗וֹן אֶת־ נִקְמַת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ נִקְמַ֖ת הֵיכָלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl nā·sîm ū·p̄ə·lê·ṭîm mê·’e·reṣ bā·ḇel lə·hag·gîḏ bə·ṣî·yō·wn ’eṯ- niq·maṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū niq·maṯ hê·ḵā·lōw
verses.literal: Listen to the fugitives and refugees from the land of Babylon declaring in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God the vengeance for His temple

verses.original: הַשְׁמִ֣יעוּ אֶל־ בָּבֶ֣ל׀ רַ֠בִּים כָּל־ דֹּ֨רְכֵי קֶ֜שֶׁת חֲנ֧וּ עָלֶ֣יהָ סָבִ֗יב אַל־ יְהִיָ֙־ פְּלֵטָ֔ה שַׁלְּמוּ־ לָ֣הּ כְּפָעֳלָ֔הּ כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשְׂתָ֖ה עֲשׂוּ־ לָ֑הּ כִּ֧י אֶל־ יְהוָ֛ה זָ֖דָה אֶל־ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: haš·mî·‘ū ’el- bā·ḇel rab·bîm kāl- dō·rə·ḵê qe·šeṯ ḥă·nū ‘ā·le·hā sā·ḇîḇ ’al- yə·hi·yå̄- pə·lê·ṭāh šal·lə·mū- lāh kə·p̄ā·‘o·lāh kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śə·ṯāh ‘ă·śū- lāh kî ’el- Yah·weh zā·ḏāh ’el- qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Summon the archers against Babylon all who string the bow Encamp . . . all around her let no one . . . escape Repay her according to her deeds do to her as she has done For she has defied . . . the LORD the Holy One of Israel

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן יִפְּל֥וּ בַחוּרֶ֖יהָ בִּרְחֹבֹתֶ֑יהָ וְכָל־ אַנְשֵׁ֨י מִלְחַמְתָּ֥הּ יִדַּ֛מּוּ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên yip·pə·lū ḇa·ḥū·re·hā bir·ḥō·ḇō·ṯe·hā wə·ḵāl ’an·šê mil·ḥam·tāh yid·dam·mū bay·yō·wm ha·hū nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Therefore her young men will fall in the streets and all her warriors . . . will be silenced in that day declares the LORD

verses.original: הִנְנִ֤י אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ זָד֔וֹן נְאֻם־ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה צְבָא֑וֹת כִּ֛י בָּ֥א יוֹמְךָ֖ עֵ֥ת פְּקַדְתִּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî ’ê·le·ḵā zā·ḏō·wn nə·’um- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ kî bā yō·wm·ḵā ‘êṯ pə·qaḏ·tî·ḵā
verses.literal: Behold I am against you O arrogant one declares the Lord GOD of Hosts for your day has come the time when I will punish you

verses.original: וְכָשַׁ֤ל זָדוֹן֙ וְנָפַ֔ל וְאֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ מֵקִ֑ים וְהִצַּ֤תִּי אֵשׁ֙ בְּעָרָ֔יו וְאָכְלָ֖ה כָּל־ סְבִיבֹתָֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵā·šal zā·ḏō·wn wə·nā·p̄al wə·’ên lōw mê·qîm wə·hiṣ·ṣat·tî ’êš bə·‘ā·rāw wə·’ā·ḵə·lāh kāl- sə·ḇî·ḇō·ṯāw
verses.literal: The arrogant one will stumble and fall with no one to pick him up And I will kindle a fire in his cities to consume all those around him

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת עֲשׁוּקִ֛ים בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל וּבְנֵי־ יְהוּדָ֖ה יַחְדָּ֑ו וְכָל־ שֹֽׁבֵיהֶם֙ הֶחֱזִ֣יקוּ בָ֔ם מֵאֲנ֖וּ שַׁלְּחָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ‘ă·šū·qîm bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇə·nê- yə·hū·ḏāh yaḥ·dāw wə·ḵāl šō·ḇê·hem he·ḥĕ·zî·qū ḇām mê·’ă·nū šal·lə·ḥām
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts says The sons of Israel are oppressed and the sons of Judah as well All their captors hold them fast refusing to release them

verses.original: גֹּאֲלָ֣ם׀ חָזָ֗ק יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ שְׁמ֔וֹ רִ֥יב יָרִ֖יב אֶת־ רִיבָ֑ם לְמַ֙עַן֙ הִרְגִּ֣יעַ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהִרְגִּ֖יז לְיֹשְׁבֵ֥י בָבֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: gō·’ă·lām ḥā·zāq Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·mōw rîḇ yā·rîḇ ’eṯ- rî·ḇām lə·ma·‘an hir·gî·a‘ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hir·gîz lə·yō·šə·ḇê ḇā·ḇel
verses.literal: Their Redeemer is strong the LORD of Hosts is His name He will fervently plead . . . their case so that He may bring rest to the earth but turmoil to those who live in Babylon

verses.original: חֶ֥רֶב עַל־ כַּשְׂדִּ֖ים נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י בָבֶ֔ל וְאֶל־ שָׂרֶ֖יהָ וְאֶל־ חֲכָמֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥe·reḇ ‘al- kaś·dîm nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·’el- yō·šə·ḇê ḇā·ḇel wə·’el- śā·re·hā wə·’el- ḥă·ḵā·me·hā
verses.literal: A sword is against the Chaldeans declares the LORD against those who live in Babylon and against her officials and wise men

verses.original: חֶ֥רֶב אֶל־ הַבַּדִּ֖ים וְנֹאָ֑לוּ חֶ֥רֶב אֶל־ גִּבּוֹרֶ֖יהָ וָחָֽתּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥe·reḇ ’el- hab·bad·dîm wə·nō·’ā·lū ḥe·reḇ ’el- gib·bō·w·re·hā wā·ḥāt·tū
verses.literal: A sword is against her false prophets and they will become fools A sword is against her warriors and they will be filled with terror

verses.original: חֶ֜רֶב אֶל־ סוּסָ֣יו וְאֶל־ רִכְבּ֗וֹ וְאֶל־ כָּל־ הָעֶ֛רֶב אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּתוֹכָ֖הּ וְהָי֣וּ לְנָשִׁ֑ים חֶ֥רֶב אֶל־ אוֹצְרֹתֶ֖יהָ וּבֻזָּֽזוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥe·reḇ ’el- sū·sāw wə·’el- riḵ·bōw wə·’el- kāl- hā·‘e·reḇ ’ă·šer bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh wə·hā·yū lə·nā·šîm ḥe·reḇ ’el- ’ō·wṣ·rō·ṯe·hā ū·ḇuz·zā·zū
verses.literal: A sword is against her horses and chariots and against all the foreigners in her midst and they will become like women A sword is against her treasuries and they will be plundered

verses.original: חֹ֥רֶב אֶל־ מֵימֶ֖יהָ וְיָבֵ֑שׁוּ כִּ֣י אֶ֤רֶץ פְּסִלִים֙ הִ֔יא וּבָאֵימִ֖ים יִתְהֹלָֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥō·reḇ ’el- mê·me·hā wə·yā·ḇê·šū kî ’e·reṣ pə·si·lîm hî ū·ḇā·’ê·mîm yiṯ·hō·lā·lū
verses.literal: A drought is upon her waters and they will be dried up For it is a land of graven images and the people go mad over idols

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן יֵשְׁב֤וּ צִיִּים֙ אֶת־ אִיִּ֔ים וְיָ֥שְׁבוּ בָ֖הּ בְּנ֣וֹת יַֽעֲנָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־ תֵשֵׁ֥ב עוֹד֙ לָנֶ֔צַח וְלֹ֥א תִשְׁכּ֖וֹן עַד־ דּ֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên yê·šə·ḇū ṣî·yîm ’eṯ- ’î·yîm wə·yā·šə·ḇū ḇāh bə·nō·wṯ ya·‘ă·nāh wə·lō- ṯê·šêḇ ‘ō·wḏ lā·ne·ṣaḥ wə·lō ṯiš·kō·wn ‘aḏ- dō·wr wā·ḏō·wr
verses.literal: So the desert creatures and hyenas will live there and ostriches will dwell there It will never . . . . . . again be inhabited or lived in from generation to generation

verses.original: כְּמַהְפֵּכַ֨ת אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת־ סְדֹ֧ם וְאֶת־ עֲמֹרָ֛ה וְאֶת־ שְׁכֵנֶ֖יהָ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה לֹֽא־ יֵשֵׁ֥ב שָׁם֙ אִ֔ישׁ וְלֹֽא־ יָג֥וּר בָּ֖הּ בֶּן־ אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kə·mah·pê·ḵaṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- sə·ḏōm wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·mō·rāh wə·’eṯ- šə·ḵê·ne·hā nə·’um- Yah·weh lō- yê·šêḇ šām ’îš wə·lō- yā·ḡūr bāh ben- ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah along with their neighbors declares the LORD no one will dwell there no man . . . will abide there

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה עַ֥ם בָּ֖א מִצָּפ֑וֹן וְג֤וֹי גָּדוֹל֙ וּמְלָכִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים יֵעֹ֖רוּ מִיַּרְכְּתֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ‘am bā miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn wə·ḡō·w gā·ḏō·wl ū·mə·lā·ḵîm rab·bîm yê·‘ō·rū mî·yar·kə·ṯê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Behold an army is coming from the north a great nation and many kings are stirred up from the ends of the earth

verses.original: קֶ֣שֶׁת וְכִידֹ֞ן יַחֲזִ֗יקוּ אַכְזָרִ֥י הֵ֙מָּה֙ וְלֹ֣א יְרַחֵ֔מוּ קוֹלָם֙ כַּיָּ֣ם יֶהֱמֶ֔ה וְעַל־ סוּסִ֖ים יִרְכָּ֑בוּ עָר֗וּךְ כְּאִישׁ֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה עָלַ֖יִךְ בַּת־ בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: qe·šeṯ wə·ḵî·ḏōn ya·ḥă·zî·qū ’aḵ·zā·rî hêm·māh wə·lō yə·ra·ḥê·mū qō·w·lām kay·yām ye·hĕ·meh wə·‘al- sū·sîm yir·kā·ḇū ‘ā·rūḵ kə·’îš lam·mil·ḥā·māh ‘ā·la·yiḵ baṯ- bā·ḇel
verses.literal: They grasp the bow and spear they are cruel and merciless Their voice roars like the sea and they ride upon horses lined up like men in formation against you O Daughter of Babylon

verses.original: שָׁמַ֧ע מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֛ל אֶת־ שִׁמְעָ֖ם וְרָפ֣וּ יָדָ֑יו צָרָה֙ הֶחֱזִיקַ֔תְהוּ חִ֖יל כַּיּוֹלֵדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘ me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ’eṯ- šim·‘ām wə·rā·p̄ū yā·ḏāw ṣā·rāh he·ḥĕ·zî·qaṯ·hū ḥîl kay·yō·w·lê·ḏāh
verses.literal: The king of Babylon has heard the report and his hands hang limp Anguish has gripped him pain like that of a woman in labor

verses.original: הִ֠נֵּה כְּאַרְיֵ֞ה יַעֲלֶ֨ה מִגְּא֣וֹן הַיַּרְדֵּן֮ אֶל־ נְוֵ֣ה אֵיתָן֒ כִּֽי־ אַרְגִּ֤עָה אֲרוּצֵם מֵֽעָלֶ֔יהָ וּמִ֥י בָח֖וּר אֵלֶ֣יהָ אֶפְקֹ֑ד כִּ֣י מִ֤י כָמ֙וֹנִי֙ וּמִ֣י יוֹעִדֶ֔נִּי וּמִֽי־ זֶ֣ה רֹעֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲמֹ֖ד לְפָנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh kə·’ar·yêh ya·‘ă·leh mig·gə·’ō·wn hay·yar·dên ’el- nə·wêh ’ê·ṯān kî- ’ar·gi·‘āh ʾă·rū·ṣēm mê·‘ā·le·hā ū·mî ḇā·ḥūr ’ê·le·hā ’ep̄·qōḏ kî mî ḵā·mō·w·nî ū·mî yō·w·‘i·ḏen·nî ū·mî- zeh rō·‘eh ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·mōḏ lə·p̄ā·nāy
verses.literal: Behold one will come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan to the watered pasture . . . For in an instant I will chase Babylon from her land Who is the chosen one I will appoint for this For who is like Me and who can challenge Me What . . . shepherd can stand against Me

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן שִׁמְע֣וּ עֲצַת־ יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָעַץ֙ אֶל־ בָּבֶ֔ל וּמַ֨חְשְׁבוֹתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָשַׁ֖ב אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים אִם־ לֹ֤א יִסְחָבוּם֙ צְעִירֵ֣י הַצֹּ֔אן אִם־ לֹ֥א יַשִּׁ֛ים עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם נָוֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên šim·‘ū ‘ă·ṣaṯ- Yah·weh ’ă·šer yā·‘aṣ ’el- bā·ḇel ū·maḥ·šə·ḇō·w·ṯāw ’ă·šer ḥā·šaḇ ’el- ’e·reṣ kaś·dîm ’im- lō yis·ḥā·ḇūm ṣə·‘î·rê haṣ·ṣōn ’im- lō yaš·šîm ‘ă·lê·hem nā·weh
verses.literal: Therefore hear the plans that the LORD has drawn up against Babylon and the strategies He has devised against the land of the Chaldeans Surely . . . the little ones of the flock will be dragged away certainly . . . their pasture will be made desolate because of them

verses.original: מִקּוֹל֙ נִתְפְּשָׂ֣ה בָבֶ֔ל נִרְעֲשָׁ֖ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וּזְעָקָ֖ה בַּגּוֹיִ֥ם נִשְׁמָֽע׃ס
verses.transliteration: miq·qō·wl niṯ·pə·śāh ḇā·ḇel nir·‘ă·šāh hā·’ā·reṣ ū·zə·‘ā·qāh bag·gō·w·yim niš·mā‘
verses.literal: At the sound of Babylon’s capture the earth will quake a cry will be heard among the nations
